tool.name: Braintrust
tool.description: Commercial AI observability and evaluation platform for tracing agents, running evals and experiments, and building datasets from production logs.
strengths: SDKs for TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, Ruby, C#
Hybrid data plane on AWS, GCP or Azure
Unlimited users even on free tier
tool.pricing: Starter $0/month (1 GB processed data, 10k scores, 14-day retention), Pro $249/month (5 GB, 50k scores, 30-day retention), Enterprise custom.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.
tool.practitionerNote: Suits eval-heavy teams that want experiments and production logs in one place. For data-sensitive workloads the Enterprise hybrid model keeps traces, datasets and prompts in your cloud while Braintrust runs the UI and auth control plane.

dataResidency.detail: Enterprise hybrid and self-hosted deployments keep traces, logs, datasets and prompts in the customer's cloud account and region. Hosted-SaaS regions are not stated.

deployment.detail: Hosted SaaS, or Enterprise-only hybrid with a customer data plane (Terraform for AWS, GCP, Azure) and a Braintrust-managed control plane.

auditLogging.detail: The security docs mention only monitoring API key usage through activity logs. No dedicated audit-log feature was verified.

soc2.detail: Braintrust states it is SOC 2 Type II compliant.

iso27001.detail: The Braintrust security docs do not mention ISO 27001, and the Trust Center did not render certification details.

iso42001.detail: The Braintrust security docs do not mention ISO 42001.

euAiAct.detail: Observability and evaluation tooling, not an AI system placed on the market. Obligations rest with the deployer.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary SaaS. Hybrid deployment still depends on the Braintrust-managed control plane.
